Package global.thalion.ttio.workbench

package global.thalion.ttio.workbench
TTI-O Workbench Client SDK.

Client surface against tti-workbench-server v1.0.0+ -- the multi-worker ObjC/GNUstep/libwebsockets daemon. Distinct from TransportClient which targets the Python reference server (no auth, no container_uri, no project/owner).

W1 (this package and its sub-packages) ships:

  • global.thalion.ttio.workbench.auth -- login flow, RFC 6238 TOTP, Session token holder.
  • global.thalion.ttio.workbench.transport -- workbench-aware upload + download + filtered streaming + resumable uploads over the ttio-transport WebSocket subprotocol.

Future Ws add: client-side cohort + pipeline + job + session surfaces (W2-W4), full-coverage GUI integration via tio-browser (W5), and SDK polish + crypto + federation (W6).

The Python equivalent lives at ttio.workbench in the python/ tree. The two clients share JSON shapes and acceptance criteria byte-for-byte; the W1 acceptance test asserts a cross-language equivalence by uploading identical payloads from both sides against a real daemon.
